blocks.en: Process Equipment (Upper Middle)

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Understand sterile filtration system configurations (aseptically assembled, SIP multi-use, single-use) and their facility design implications / 理解無菌過濾系統的三種組態（無菌組裝式、SIP 多用式、單次使用式）及其對設施設計的影響
blocks.en: Understand sterile filtration system configurations (aseptically assembled, SIP multi-use, single-use) and their facility design implications

blocks.zh: Know the critical design considerations for sterile filtration including redundant filtration, filter integrity testing, and bulk product holding / 掌握無菌過濾的關鍵設計考量：冗餘過濾、濾膜完整性測試、散裝產品靜置保存
blocks.en: Know the critical design considerations for sterile filtration including redundant filtration, filter integrity testing, and bulk product holding

blocks.zh: Describe container preparation processes: washing machines, depyrogenation tunnels, and ready-to-use container systems / 說明容器準備流程：洗瓶機、去熱原隧道，以及即用型容器系統
blocks.en: Describe container preparation processes: washing machines, depyrogenation tunnels, and ready-to-use container systems

blocks.zh: Explain closure preparation requirements and the importance of endotoxin control / 解釋膠塞準備要求及內毒素控制的重要性
blocks.en: Explain closure preparation requirements and the importance of endotoxin control

blocks.zh: Master the design principles for aseptic filling machines, including RABS/isolator integration, UAF protection, and IPC considerations / 掌握無菌充填機的設計原則，包括 RABS/隔離器整合、單向氣流保護、製程中管制
blocks.en: Master the design principles for aseptic filling machines, including RABS/isolator integration, UAF protection, and IPC considerations

blocks.zh: Understand BFS (Blow-Fill-Seal) technology: process steps, advantages, limitations, and facility design considerations / 了解 BFS（吹瓶-充填-密封）技術：製程步驟、優缺點及設施設計考量
blocks.en: Understand BFS (Blow-Fill-Seal) technology: process steps, advantages, limitations, and facility design considerations

blocks.zh: Describe lyophilization equipment selection, loading/unloading systems, CIP/SIP requirements, and production capacity planning / 說明凍乾設備選型、進出料系統、CIP/SIP 要求及產能規劃
blocks.en: Describe lyophilization equipment selection, loading/unloading systems, CIP/SIP requirements, and production capacity planning

blocks.zh: Know container closure system types, CCI lifecycle approach, and CCIT methods / 了解容器密封系統類型、CCI 生命週期方法及完整性測試方法
blocks.en: Know container closure system types, CCI lifecycle approach, and CCIT methods

blocks.zh: Understand vial capping/crimping operations, PAT applications, and particulate control / 理解鋁蓋壓封作業、PAT 應用及微粒控制
blocks.en: Understand vial capping/crimping operations, PAT applications, and particulate control

blocks.en: Section Navigation

blocks.zh: 3.2.4 Sterile Filtration 3.2.4 無菌過濾
blocks.en: 3.2.4 Sterile Filtration

blocks.zh: 導師解析
blocks.en: Tutor Analysis

blocks.zh: 核心概念：無菌過濾的三大系統組態
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three Sterile Filtration System Configurations

blocks.zh: 製藥產業中，無菌過濾系統可分為三大類：
blocks.en: In the pharmaceutical industry, sterile filtration systems fall into three main categories:

blocks.zh: 無菌組裝式多用系統（舊式）：各元件分別清洗、滅菌後，在 ISO 5/Grade A 環境下手動組裝。風險高，正逐步淘汰。
blocks.en: Aseptically assembled multi-use systems (legacy): the components are cleaned and sterilized separately, then assembled manually in an ISO 5/Grade A environment. The risk is high and these systems are being phased out.

blocks.zh: SIP 多用系統（主流）：組裝後封閉系統直接通入純蒸汽進行就地滅菌，無需打開連接點，大幅降低人為污染風險。
blocks.en: SIP multi-use systems (mainstream): after assembly, the closed system is sterilized in place with clean steam, with no need to open connection points, which greatly reduces the risk of contamination from human intervention.

blocks.zh: 預滅菌單次使用系統（趨勢）：免洗免 SIP，伽馬射線滅菌後直接使用。特別適合高效藥物（potent compounds）及 CDMO 多品項切換。
blocks.en: Pre-sterilized single-use systems (the trend): no cleaning and no SIP; the assemblies are gamma-irradiated and used as supplied. They are especially suitable for potent compounds and for CDMOs that change over between many products.

blocks.zh: 選擇依據：生產規模、產品數量、廠房新舊及法規市場要求。
blocks.en: Selection criteria: production scale, number of products, age of the facility, and regulatory requirements of the target markets.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：冗餘過濾與完整性測試
blocks.en: Key Point: Redundant Filtration and Integrity Testing

blocks.zh: 冗餘過濾（Redundant Filtration）是在過濾路徑中串聯兩個滅菌級濾膜，當其中一個膜失效時，另一個仍能提供無菌保障。這是無菌製程的安全網。
blocks.en: Redundant filtration places two sterilizing-grade filters in series in the filtration path, so that if one fails, the other still provides sterility assurance. It is the safety net of the aseptic process.

blocks.zh: 濾膜完整性測試是法規強制要求：
blocks.en: Filter integrity testing is a mandatory regulatory requirement:

blocks.zh: 使用前測試（Pre-use）：確認濾膜安裝正確且無瑕疵
blocks.en: Pre-use test: confirms the filter is correctly installed and free of defects

blocks.zh: 使用後測試（Post-use）：確認過濾過程中濾膜未受損
blocks.en: Post-use test: confirms the filter was not damaged during filtration

blocks.zh: 測試方法：泡點測試（Bubble Point）、擴散流（Forward Flow）、水侵入（Water Intrusion）
blocks.en: Test methods: Bubble Point, Forward Flow, Water Intrusion

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 建議在滅菌前進行完整性測試，但這可能破壞下游無菌路徑的滅菌狀態——因此需要透過冗餘設計來兼顧兩個風險。
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 recommends integrity testing before sterilization, but this may compromise the sterile state of the downstream path. Redundant filtration is therefore used to manage both risks.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：無菌過濾如同淨水系統
blocks.en: Analogy: Sterile Filtration Is Like a Water Purification System

blocks.zh: 想像家用淨水器有三種安裝方式：(1) 每次使用前拆開清洗再組裝；(2) 安裝好後用蒸汽消毒，不用拆開；(3) 直接買全新密封的濾芯插上去用完即丟。
blocks.en: Imagine a household water purifier with three ways of installing it: (1) take it apart, clean it and reassemble it before each use; (2) install it and sterilize it with steam without taking it apart; (3) buy a brand-new sealed cartridge, plug it in and throw it away after use.

blocks.zh: 製藥無菌過濾的三種系統也是相同邏輯——從費工高風險的手動組裝，到免洗免消毒的一次性系統，技術演進方向就是「減少人為操作、降低污染風險」。
blocks.en: The three pharmaceutical sterile filtration systems follow the same logic. The technology has evolved from labor-intensive, high-risk manual assembly to disposable systems that need no cleaning or sterilization, with the aim of reducing human intervention and contamination risk.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務觀點
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Perspective

blocks.zh: CDMO 需處理多種不同產品，單次使用系統的優勢特別明顯：
blocks.en: A CDMO handles many different products, so the advantages of single-use systems are especially clear:

blocks.zh: 免除跨產品清潔驗證的巨大負擔
blocks.en: Eliminates the heavy burden of cross-product cleaning validation

blocks.zh: 消除殘留交叉污染風險
blocks.en: Removes the risk of cross-contamination from residues

blocks.zh: 可預先建立庫存，縮短換線時間
blocks.en: Allows stock to be built up in advance and shortens changeover time

blocks.zh: 特別適合小批量、高價值的生物製劑生產
blocks.en: Particularly suited to small-batch, high-value biologics production

blocks.zh: Bulk Product Holding / 散裝產品靜置保存
blocks.en: Bulk Product Holding

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Hold Time 驗證是法規稽查重點
blocks.en: Key Point: Hold Time Validation Is an Inspection Focus

blocks.zh: 散裝藥液的「保存時間限制」是製程驗證中經常被稽查員關注的項目：
blocks.en: Hold time limits for bulk drug solution are an item inspectors frequently focus on in process validation:

blocks.zh: 過濾前保存（Pre-filtration hold）：驗證在最長保存時間內，生物負載不會超過可接受限度
blocks.en: Pre-filtration hold: demonstrate that bioburden does not exceed the acceptable limit within the maximum hold time

blocks.zh: 過濾後無菌保存（Post-filtration sterile hold）：持續正壓監控，確保外部微生物無法進入
blocks.en: Post-filtration sterile hold: continuous positive pressure monitoring ensures that external microorganisms cannot enter

blocks.zh: 生物負載取樣必須在保存期結束後、過濾前進行——這是製程控制步驟
blocks.en: Bioburden sampling must be performed at the end of the hold period, before filtration. This is a process control step.

blocks.zh: 原則是「儘快過濾」，延長保存只能作為例外情況使用。
blocks.en: The principle is to filter as soon as possible; an extended hold may be used only as an exception.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：正壓保護如同氣球防塵
blocks.en: Analogy: Positive Pressure Protection Is Like a Balloon Keeping Dust Out

blocks.zh: 無菌散裝儲罐維持正壓，就像一個充飽氣的氣球——因為內部壓力大於外部，空氣只會從裡面往外跑，灰塵和細菌無法「逆流」進入。一旦正壓消失，就像氣球洩了氣，外部污染物就能輕易侵入。
blocks.en: A sterile bulk storage tank maintained under positive pressure is like a fully inflated balloon: because the internal pressure is higher than the outside, air can only flow outward, and dust and bacteria cannot flow back in. Once the positive pressure is lost, it is like a deflated balloon, and external contaminants can easily get in.

blocks.zh: Container Preparation / 容器準備
blocks.en: Container Preparation

blocks.zh: 核心概念：容器準備的四大污染控制
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Four Contamination Controls in Container Preparation

blocks.zh: 注射劑容器在使用前必須控制四類污染：
blocks.en: Containers for injectable products must be controlled for four types of contamination before use:

blocks.zh: 生物負載（Bioburden）：活的微生物，以 CFU 計量
blocks.en: Bioburden: viable microorganisms, measured in CFU

blocks.zh: 內毒素（Endotoxin）：革蘭氏陰性菌的細胞壁碎片，即使細菌死了，內毒素仍會引發發熱反應
blocks.en: Endotoxin: cell wall fragments of gram-negative bacteria; even when the bacteria are dead, endotoxin can still cause a pyrogenic reaction

blocks.zh: 外來微粒（Particulates）：玻璃碎片、纖維等固體微粒
blocks.en: Particulates: solid particles such as glass fragments and fibers

blocks.zh: 外來化學物質（Chemicals）：非產品配方的化學殘留
blocks.en: Chemicals: chemical residues that are not part of the product formulation

blocks.zh: 清洗去除微粒和化學物質，去熱原隧道用高溫破壞內毒素並滅菌——兩步缺一不可。
blocks.en: Washing removes particulates and chemicals; the depyrogenation tunnel uses high temperature to destroy endotoxin and sterilize. Both steps are required.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：去熱原隧道的三區設計
blocks.en: Key Point: The Three-Zone Design of the Depyrogenation Tunnel

blocks.zh: 去熱原隧道分為三個功能區域：
blocks.en: The depyrogenation tunnel is divided into three functional zones:

blocks.zh: 升溫區（Heat-up Zone）：容器從室溫逐漸加熱
blocks.en: Heat-up Zone: containers are gradually heated from room temperature

blocks.zh: 恆溫區（Dwell Zone）：維持 250–350°C，停留足夠時間以達到至少 3-log 內毒素降低
blocks.en: Dwell Zone: maintains 250–350°C with sufficient residence time to achieve at least a 3-log endotoxin reduction

blocks.zh: 冷卻區（Cool-down Zone）：必須是 ISO 5/Grade A 環境，冷卻至不影響產品的溫度
blocks.en: Cool-down Zone: must be an ISO 5/Grade A environment, cooling containers to a temperature that does not affect the product

blocks.zh: 隧道的壓差平衡至關重要——必須在充填室（ISO 5）和洗瓶室（ISO 8）之間維持正確的壓差梯度。
blocks.en: Pressure differential balance of the tunnel is critical: the correct pressure gradient must be maintained between the filling room (ISO 5) and the washing room (ISO 8).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：去熱原隧道像烤箱輸送帶
blocks.en: Analogy: The Depyrogenation Tunnel Is Like an Oven Conveyor

blocks.zh: 想像一條連續式烤箱輸送帶：玻璃瓶從一端進入，先經過預熱段，然後在超高溫段被「烤」到 250–350°C（這個溫度足以摧毀所有內毒素），最後通過冷卻段降溫。整個過程全自動、連續運行，瓶子排隊通過就像生產線上的產品一樣。
blocks.en: Picture a continuous oven conveyor: glass vials enter at one end, pass through a preheating section, are then "baked" at 250–350°C in the very high-temperature section (hot enough to destroy all endotoxin), and finally pass through a cooling section. The whole process is fully automatic and continuous, and the vials queue through it like products on a production line.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：即用型容器 (RTU) 的趨勢
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: The Trend Toward Ready-to-Use (RTU) Containers

blocks.zh: 預洗預滅菌的即用型容器（RTU, Ready-to-Use）正在迅速改變 CDMO 設施設計：
blocks.en: Pre-washed, pre-sterilized ready-to-use (RTU) containers are rapidly changing CDMO facility design:

blocks.zh: 免除洗瓶機和去熱原隧道的資本投資
blocks.en: Eliminates the capital investment in washing machines and depyrogenation tunnels

blocks.zh: 大幅減少潔淨室面積需求
blocks.en: Greatly reduces the cleanroom area required

blocks.zh: 降低公用工程（WFI、壓縮空氣、HVAC 散熱）的負荷
blocks.en: Lowers the load on utilities (WFI, compressed air, HVAC heat rejection)

blocks.zh: 特別適合小批量、高價值產品及臨床試驗階段
blocks.en: Particularly suitable for small-batch, high-value products and clinical trial stages

blocks.zh: 但需注意：必須稽核供應商的品質系統，每批需附合格證明（Certificate of Conformance）。
blocks.en: Note, however, that the supplier's quality system must be audited, and each batch must be accompanied by a Certificate of Conformance.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Exercises

blocks.zh: 為什麼塑膠容器無法使用去熱原隧道？這對內毒素控制策略有何影響？
blocks.en: Why can plastic containers not be processed in a depyrogenation tunnel? What impact does this have on the endotoxin control strategy?

blocks.zh: 去熱原隧道冷卻區失壓時，為什麼需要對冷卻區表面進行乾熱滅菌？
blocks.en: When the depyrogenation tunnel cool-down zone loses pressure, why is dry heat sterilization of the cool-down zone surfaces required?

blocks.zh: Closure Preparation / 膠塞準備
blocks.en: Closure Preparation

blocks.zh: 核心概念：膠塞處理的完整流程
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Complete Stopper Processing Flow

blocks.zh: 膠塞（Stopper）直接接觸產品，品質要求極高：
blocks.en: Stoppers come into direct contact with the product, so quality requirements are extremely high:

blocks.zh: 清洗：以水力或機械攪動去除微粒，避免再沉積（re-deposition）
blocks.en: Washing: remove particulates by hydraulic or mechanical agitation, avoiding re-deposition

blocks.zh: 最終沖洗：必須使用 WFI（注射用水）
blocks.en: Final rinse: must use WFI (water for injection)

blocks.zh: 滅菌與乾燥：清洗後儘快完成，避免濕態長時間保存滋生微生物
blocks.en: Sterilization and drying: complete as soon as possible after washing to avoid microbial growth during prolonged storage in the wet state

blocks.zh: 重點提示：凍乾產品的膠塞水分控制
blocks.en: Key Point: Stopper Moisture Control for Lyophilized Products

blocks.zh: 對於凍乾產品，膠塞的殘留水分至關重要。滅菌後膠塞中殘留的水分可能在凍乾過程中釋放，影響產品的最終含水量和穩定性。因此，膠塞滅菌製程的設計必須同時考慮滅菌效力和乾燥效果。
blocks.en: For lyophilized products, residual moisture in the stopper is critical. Moisture remaining in stoppers after sterilization may be released during lyophilization and affect the final moisture content and stability of the product. The stopper sterilization process must therefore be designed to consider both sterilization efficacy and drying effectiveness.

blocks.zh: 這是凍乾產品特有的驗證挑戰：需要證明膠塞水分不會影響產品 CQA（關鍵品質屬性）。
blocks.en: This is a validation challenge specific to lyophilized products: it must be demonstrated that stopper moisture does not affect the product CQAs (critical quality attributes).

blocks.zh: 即用型膠塞（RTU Closures）
blocks.en: Ready-to-Use Closures (RTU Closures)

blocks.zh: 與即用型容器相同的趨勢，預洗預滅菌的膠塞正在被廣泛採用：
blocks.en: Following the same trend as ready-to-use containers, pre-washed and pre-sterilized stoppers are being widely adopted:

blocks.zh: Ready-to-Sterilize（預洗型）：供應商完成清洗，用戶只需滅菌
blocks.en: Ready-to-Sterilize: the supplier completes the washing and the user only needs to sterilize

blocks.zh: Ready-to-Use（即用型）：供應商完成清洗和滅菌，用戶直接使用
blocks.en: Ready-to-Use: the supplier completes both washing and sterilization and the user uses the stoppers directly

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這進一步簡化了設施需求並縮短了換線時間。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this further simplifies facility requirements and shortens changeover time.

blocks.zh: Filling and Sealing / 充填與密封
blocks.en: Filling and Sealing

blocks.zh: 核心概念：充填是無菌製程的最高風險環節
blocks.en: Core Concept: Filling Is the Highest-Risk Step in the Aseptic Process

blocks.zh: 充填是產品在無菌過濾後唯一暴露在開放環境中的操作。這就是為什麼：
blocks.en: Filling is the only operation in which the product is exposed to the open environment after sterile filtration. This is why:

blocks.zh: 必須在 ISO 5/Grade A 環境下進行
blocks.en: it must be performed in an ISO 5/Grade A environment

blocks.zh: 必須使用 RABS 或隔離器
blocks.en: a RABS or isolator must be used

blocks.zh: 必須最大限度減少人員介入
blocks.en: personnel intervention must be minimized as far as possible

blocks.zh: 任何中斷（intervention）都必須被記錄和評估
blocks.en: every intervention must be recorded and assessed

blocks.zh: 設計要點清單：充填機的 16 項關鍵考量
blocks.en: Design Checklist: 16 Key Considerations for Filling Machines

blocks.zh: 本節列出的充填機設計要求可歸納為五大原則：
blocks.en: The filling machine design requirements listed in this section can be summarized into five principles:

blocks.zh: 隔離原則：RABS/隔離器隔離人員、手套埠操作、門互鎖
blocks.en: Isolation principle: RABS/isolator separating personnel, glove port operation, door interlocks

blocks.zh: 可清潔原則：無縫隙、無螺紋連接、316L 不鏽鋼、可拆卸高壓滅菌
blocks.en: Cleanability principle: no crevices, no threaded connections, 316L stainless steel, removable parts that can be autoclaved

blocks.zh: 單向氣流原則：最佳 UAF 氣流模式、微粒排出設計
blocks.en: Unidirectional airflow principle: optimal UAF airflow pattern, design that sweeps particles away

blocks.zh: 快速換線原則：免工具設計、最少組裝步驟、預滅菌組件
blocks.en: Rapid changeover principle: tool-free design, minimal assembly steps, pre-sterilized components

blocks.zh: 製程控制原則：IPC 取樣不中斷、秤重系統、氮氣置換
blocks.en: Process control principle: IPC sampling without interruption, check-weighing system, nitrogen overlay

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：充填機像手術室中的手術台
blocks.en: Analogy: The Filling Machine Is Like an Operating Table in a Surgical Suite

blocks.zh: 充填機所在的 ISO 5 環境就像手術室裡的無菌區：手術刀（充填針）、手術台（充填工位）和所有接觸組織的器械（產品接觸面）都必須滅菌。外科醫生透過手套操作（glove port），護士從外部傳遞器械（barrier transfer），整個過程中空調系統維持正壓和單向氣流以排除微粒。
blocks.en: The ISO 5 environment around the filling machine is like the sterile field in an operating room: the scalpel (filling needle), the operating table (filling station) and every instrument that touches tissue (product contact surfaces) must be sterile. The surgeon works through gloves (glove port), nurses pass instruments in from outside (barrier transfer), and throughout the procedure the air handling system maintains positive pressure and unidirectional airflow to remove particles.

blocks.zh: 凍乾產品的膠塞半插設計
blocks.en: Partial Stopper Insertion for Lyophilized Products

blocks.zh: 凍乾產品的膠塞在充填後不會完全壓入瓶口，而是「半插」（partially seated）。這是因為凍乾過程中，溶劑需要從瓶口逸出（昇華和解吸階段）。凍乾完成後，凍乾機的層板下壓將膠塞完全壓入瓶中。
blocks.en: For lyophilized products, stoppers are not fully pressed into the vial neck after filling but are "partially seated". This is because solvent must escape through the vial opening during lyophilization (the sublimation and desorption stages). After lyophilization is complete, the shelves of the freeze dryer press down to seat the stoppers fully in the vials.

blocks.zh: 從充填機到凍乾機之間，這些半插膠塞的瓶子必須全程在 ISO 5/Grade A 環境下受保護——這是設施佈局設計的關鍵考量。
blocks.en: From the filling machine to the freeze dryer, vials with partially seated stoppers must be protected in an ISO 5/Grade A environment at all times. This is a key consideration in facility layout design.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：三種充填方式的比較
blocks.en: Key Point: Comparison of the Three Filling Methods

blocks.zh: 無論哪種方式，都建議配備自動秤重反饋系統（check-weighing），實現充填量的即時監控和調整。
blocks.en: Whichever method is used, an automatic check-weighing feedback system is recommended, enabling real-time monitoring and adjustment of fill volume.

blocks.zh: Blow, Fill, and Seal (BFS) Technology / 吹瓶-充填-密封技術
blocks.en: Blow, Fill, and Seal (BFS) Technology

blocks.zh: 核心概念：BFS 一體成型的革命性設計
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Revolutionary Integrated Design of BFS

blocks.zh: BFS 技術將三個傳統上分離的步驟整合在一台機器上：
blocks.en: BFS technology integrates three traditionally separate steps in a single machine:

blocks.zh: 吹瓶（Blow）：塑膠粒經高溫擠出成為管狀（parison），再吹模成型為容器
blocks.en: Blow: plastic pellets are extruded at high temperature into a tube (parison), which is then blow-molded into the container

blocks.zh: 充填（Fill）：成型後立即充填產品
blocks.en: Fill: the product is filled immediately after the container is formed

blocks.zh: 密封（Seal）：充填後立即熱封密封
blocks.en: Seal: the container is heat-sealed immediately after filling

blocks.zh: 整個過程中，容器暴露在環境中的時間極短，大幅降低污染風險。
blocks.en: Throughout the process the container is exposed to the environment for a very short time, which greatly reduces contamination risk.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：BFS 像自動包裝冰棒的機器
blocks.en: Analogy: BFS Is Like an Automatic Ice Pop Packaging Machine

blocks.zh: 傳統充填像是先買好空瓶、洗瓶、消毒、再灌裝液體、再蓋蓋子——每一步都有污染風險。BFS 就像自動冰棒包裝機：塑膠管加熱融化、吹成容器形狀、立刻灌入液體、瞬間熱封——從無到有一氣呵成，容器幾乎沒有機會接觸外界環境。
blocks.en: Traditional filling is like buying empty bottles, washing them, sterilizing them, filling them with liquid and then capping them, and every step carries contamination risk. BFS is like an automatic ice pop packaging machine: the plastic tube is heated and melted, blown into the shape of the container, filled with liquid immediately and heat-sealed in an instant. The container is made from nothing in one continuous operation and has almost no chance to come into contact with the outside environment.

blocks.zh: 設施設計挑戰：BFS 的「灰區/白區」概念
blocks.en: Facility Design Challenge: The "Grey Side/White Side" Concept of BFS

blocks.zh: BFS 機器的擠出區產生大量熱量和塑膠微粒。解決方案是將機器分為兩側：
blocks.en: The extrusion area of a BFS machine generates a great deal of heat and plastic particulates. The solution is to divide the machine into two sides:

blocks.zh: 白區（White Side）：充填和成型區域，維持潔淨環境
blocks.en: White Side: the forming and filling area, kept clean

blocks.zh: 灰區（Grey Side）：機械系統區域，便於維護和散熱
blocks.en: Grey Side: the mechanical systems area, which allows easy maintenance and heat dissipation

blocks.zh: 這種設計透過實體牆將兩個區域分隔，既保護了無菌充填區，又方便了設備維護。HVAC 系統必須能夠應對擠出區產生的巨大熱負荷。
blocks.en: This design separates the two areas with a physical wall, which protects the sterile filling area while keeping equipment maintenance convenient. The HVAC system must be able to handle the very large heat load generated by the extrusion area.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：BFS 的定位
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Positioning of BFS

blocks.zh: BFS 最適合大批量、長時間連續充填的產品（如眼藥水、吸入劑、小容量注射液）。對 CDMO 而言：
blocks.en: BFS is best suited to products filled in large batches over long continuous runs (such as eye drops, inhalation products and small-volume injections). For a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 高初期投資但營運成本低
blocks.en: High initial investment but low operating cost

blocks.zh: 免除容器和膠塞準備的整條生產線
blocks.en: Eliminates the entire container and stopper preparation line

blocks.zh: 需要注意可萃取物/浸出物（E&L）的評估
blocks.en: Extractables and leachables (E&L) must be evaluated

blocks.zh: 不適合需要凍乾的產品或對溫度/氧氣極敏感的生物製劑
blocks.en: Not suitable for products requiring lyophilization or for biologics that are highly sensitive to temperature or oxygen

blocks.zh: 3.2.5 Lyophilization / 凍乾（冷凍乾燥）
blocks.en: 3.2.5 Lyophilization

blocks.zh: 核心概念：凍乾的三階段與 15 步操作序列
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three Stages of Lyophilization and the 15-Step Operating Sequence

blocks.zh: 凍乾的核心目的是提高產品在乾燥狀態下的穩定性。三個關鍵階段：
blocks.en: The core purpose of lyophilization is to improve the stability of the product in the dry state. There are three key stages:

blocks.zh: 冷凍（Freezing）：將產品降溫至共熔點/玻璃轉化溫度以下，使水分結冰
blocks.en: Freezing: the product is cooled below its eutectic point/glass transition temperature so that the water freezes

blocks.zh: 昇華/初級乾燥（Primary Drying）：在真空條件下，冰直接昇華為水蒸氣，被冷凝器捕捉
blocks.en: Sublimation/Primary Drying: under vacuum, ice sublimes directly to water vapor, which is captured by the condenser

blocks.zh: 解吸/二級乾燥（Secondary Drying）：移除結合水，進一步降低含水量至目標值
blocks.en: Desorption/Secondary Drying: bound water is removed, further reducing the moisture content to the target value

blocks.zh: 但完整的操作序列遠不止這三步——從清洗、滅菌、冷卻、洩漏測試到裝載、凍乾、出料、除霜、清洗，共 15 個步驟。
blocks.en: The complete operating sequence involves far more than these three steps: from cleaning, sterilization, cooling and leak testing through loading, lyophilization, unloading, defrosting and cleaning, there are 15 steps in total.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：凍乾機是產線瓶頸
blocks.en: Key Point: The Freeze Dryer Is the Bottleneck of the Production Line

blocks.zh: 凍乾是整條無菌充填線中最耗時的環節，一個凍乾週期可能需要 24–72 小時甚至更長。因此：
blocks.en: Lyophilization is the most time-consuming step in the entire aseptic filling line; a single cycle may take 24–72 hours or even longer. Therefore:

blocks.zh: 凍乾機大小的選擇直接決定整條產線的產出效率
blocks.en: The size of the freeze dryer directly determines the output efficiency of the whole line

blocks.zh: 通常需要 2 台或更多凍乾機來匹配一條充填線的產能
blocks.en: Two or more freeze dryers are usually needed to match the capacity of one filling line

blocks.zh: 計算產能時必須考慮完整週期時間（含清洗、滅菌、除霜、維護保養）
blocks.en: Capacity calculations must take the full cycle time into account (including cleaning, sterilization, defrosting, and maintenance)

blocks.zh: 凍乾製程優化應在開發早期完成，因為對產能影響巨大
blocks.en: Lyophilization process optimization should be completed early in development, because it has a major impact on capacity

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：凍乾機像太空級冷凍乾燥機
blocks.en: Analogy: The Freeze Dryer Is Like a Space-Grade Food Dryer

blocks.zh: 想像一台巨型太空食品乾燥機：先將食物急速冷凍，然後在極低壓的真空中，冰晶不經過液態直接「蒸發」（昇華）。最後的產品像是一塊海綿狀的乾燥餅，加水後可以恢復原狀。不同的是，製藥用凍乾機必須在無菌條件下操作，而且每批之間必須完全清洗和滅菌。
blocks.en: Imagine a giant space food dryer: the food is first flash-frozen, and then under extremely low-pressure vacuum the ice crystals "evaporate" (sublime) without passing through the liquid state. The final product is a dry, sponge-like cake that returns to its original form when water is added. The difference is that a pharmaceutical freeze dryer must be operated under aseptic conditions, and must be fully cleaned and sterilized between batches.

blocks.zh: 進出料系統：從手動到全自動的演進
blocks.en: Loading/Unloading Systems: The Evolution from Manual to Fully Automated

blocks.zh: 凍乾機的裝載（loading）和卸載（unloading）是無菌製程中的高風險環節：
blocks.en: Loading and unloading of the freeze dryer are high-risk steps in the aseptic process:

blocks.zh: 手動裝載：操作員逐盤放入，風險最高
blocks.en: Manual loading: operators place trays one by one; the highest risk

blocks.zh: 半自動裝載：部分自動化，減少人為操作
blocks.en: Semi-automatic loading: partly automated, reducing human intervention

blocks.zh: 全自動裝載：自動托盤預裝 + 同步送入，或逐層堆疊 + 自動升降器
blocks.en: Fully automatic loading: automatic pre-loaded trays with simultaneous push-in, or layer-by-layer stacking with an automatic lifter

blocks.zh: 全自動系統是首選，尤其當同一套自動化系統能服務多台凍乾機時，產能利用率最高。
blocks.en: A fully automatic system is the first choice, especially when one automation system can serve several freeze dryers, which gives the highest capacity utilization.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：凍乾機的清洗與滅菌挑戰
blocks.en: Key Point: Cleaning and Sterilization Challenges for Freeze Dryers

blocks.zh: 濕熱滅菌（蒸汽）是最常用的方法，但有其挑戰：
blocks.en: Moist heat sterilization (steam) is the most commonly used method, but it has its challenges:

blocks.zh: 需要達到高溫高壓——凍乾機的設計必須能承受壓力容器等級
blocks.en: High temperature and pressure are required, so the freeze dryer must be designed to pressure vessel standards

blocks.zh: 冷卻耗時——增加了批間轉換時間
blocks.en: Cooling takes time, which lengthens the batch-to-batch turnaround

blocks.zh: 熱膨脹-收縮的機械應力可能導致密封墊劣化，增加洩漏風險
blocks.en: Mechanical stress from thermal expansion and contraction may degrade gaskets and increase the risk of leaks

blocks.zh: 殘留水分可能影響後續的洩漏率測試
blocks.en: Residual moisture may affect the subsequent leak rate test

blocks.zh: VHP 除污是新興替代方案，特別適合無法承受壓力的舊式設備或小型實驗室設備，但商業規模應用仍然有限。
blocks.en: VHP decontamination is an emerging alternative, particularly suitable for older equipment or small laboratory units that cannot withstand pressure, but its application at commercial scale remains limited.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：凍乾機是最昂貴的單一設備
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: The Freeze Dryer Is the Most Expensive Single Piece of Equipment

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，凍乾機的投資決策是最具策略性的設備選擇之一：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the investment decision on a freeze dryer is one of the most strategic equipment choices:

blocks.zh: 一台商業級凍乾機的成本可達數百萬美元
blocks.en: A commercial-scale freeze dryer can cost several million US dollars

blocks.zh: 配置錯誤（太大或太小）直接影響數年的營收
blocks.en: A wrong configuration (too large or too small) directly affects revenue for years

blocks.zh: Pass-through 設計（穿透式）可分隔裝載側和卸載側的潔淨等級
blocks.en: A pass-through design can separate the cleanliness grades of the loading side and the unloading side

blocks.zh: 自動裝卸系統的投資回收期通常在 2–3 年內
blocks.en: The payback period for an automatic loading/unloading system is typically within 2–3 years

blocks.zh: 凍乾週期優化對產能影響極大——縮短 10% 的週期時間可能增加 10% 以上的年產能
blocks.en: Optimizing the lyophilization cycle has a major impact on capacity: a 10% shorter cycle time may increase annual capacity by more than 10%

blocks.zh: 一條充填線的充填速度是每小時 10,000 瓶，凍乾週期需要 48 小時，每台凍乾機可裝載 50,000 瓶。若要維持充填線不停機，至少需要幾台凍乾機？
blocks.en: A filling line fills 10,000 vials per hour, the lyophilization cycle takes 48 hours, and each freeze dryer holds 50,000 vials. How many freeze dryers are needed at a minimum to keep the filling line running without stopping?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISPE 建議在開發早期就優化凍乾製程？這與設施設計有什麼關係？
blocks.en: Why does ISPE recommend optimizing the lyophilization process early in development? How does this relate to facility design?

blocks.zh: VHP 除污為什麼特別適合舊式凍乾機？它的限制是什麼？
blocks.en: Why is VHP decontamination particularly suitable for older freeze dryers? What are its limitations?

blocks.zh: 凍乾機規格選定的關鍵參數
blocks.en: Key Parameters for Freeze Dryer Specification

blocks.zh: 正確規格化凍乾機需要的製程數據包括：
blocks.en: Correctly specifying a freeze dryer requires the following process data:

blocks.zh: 3.2.6 Container Closure Systems / 容器密封系統
blocks.en: 3.2.6 Container Closure Systems

blocks.zh: 核心概念：容器密封完整性（CCI）生命週期
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Container Closure Integrity (CCI) Lifecycle

blocks.zh: CCI 不是一次性的測試，而是一個貫穿產品生命週期的驗證體系：
blocks.en: CCI is not a one-time test but a verification system that runs throughout the product lifecycle:

blocks.zh: 開發階段：選擇相容的容器/膠塞/鋁蓋組合，定義 CPP，進行初始 CCI 測試
blocks.en: Development stage: select a compatible container/stopper/cap combination, define CPPs, and perform initial CCI testing

blocks.zh: 生產階段：監控和控制 CPP（如壓蓋力、膠塞壓縮量），進行統計取樣或 100% 檢查
blocks.en: Manufacturing stage: monitor and control CPPs (such as crimping force and stopper compression) and perform statistical sampling or 100% inspection

blocks.zh: 安定性階段：長期穩定性試驗中監控密封完整性是否隨時間劣化
blocks.en: Stability stage: monitor in long-term stability studies whether seal integrity degrades over time

blocks.zh: 每一種容器/膠塞組合都需要獨立驗證——不同的膠塞配方或規格搭配同一種瓶子，CCI 表現可能完全不同。
blocks.en: Each container/stopper combination must be validated independently: a different stopper formulation or specification paired with the same vial may give completely different CCI performance.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：密封方式的兩大類別
blocks.en: Key Point: The Two Categories of Closure

blocks.zh: 熔合密封（Fusion）：安瓿瓶和 BFS 容器——單一材料成型密封，系統較簡單，但 EU Annex 1 要求 100% 完整性檢查
blocks.en: Fusion seals: ampoules and BFS containers; the container is formed and sealed from a single material, so the system is simpler, but EU Annex 1 requires 100% integrity inspection

blocks.zh: 彈性體密封（Elastomeric）：西林瓶、預填充注射器、卡式瓶——使用膠塞 + 鋁蓋壓封，涉及多個組件的介面，系統較複雜
blocks.en: Elastomeric seals: vials, prefilled syringes and cartridges; these use a stopper plus an aluminum crimp cap and involve interfaces between multiple components, so the system is more complex

blocks.zh: 美國 FDA 和歐盟 EMA 均認為：西林瓶在鋁蓋壓封完成前，密封系統不算完整。這一立場直接影響了壓蓋區的環境等級要求。
blocks.en: Both the US FDA and the EU EMA take the position that a vial closure system is not considered integral until the crimp cap has been applied. This position directly affects the environmental grade required for the capping area.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：CCI 如同保溫瓶的密封
blocks.en: Analogy: CCI Is Like the Seal of a Thermos Flask

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性就像保溫瓶的蓋子——不管保溫瓶做得多好，如果蓋子沒蓋緊，熱量就會散失（無菌性喪失）。CCI 的生命週期方法就是確保：蓋子選得對（開發）、每次都蓋好（生產）、放久了也不會鬆（穩定性）。
blocks.en: Container closure integrity is like the lid of a thermos flask: however well the flask is made, if the lid is not tight, heat escapes (loss of sterility). The CCI lifecycle approach ensures that the lid is the right one (development), that it is closed properly every time (manufacturing), and that it does not loosen with age (stability).

blocks.zh: Container Closure Integrity Test Methods / 容器密封完整性測試方法
blocks.en: Container Closure Integrity Test Methods

blocks.zh: 核心概念：CCIT 方法的三層應用
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three Tiers of CCIT Method Application

blocks.zh: CCI 測試方法按應用場景分為三層：
blocks.en: CCI test methods fall into three tiers according to the application scenario:

blocks.zh: 開發階段測試：所有方法都適用——建立密封完整性的基線數據和接受標準
blocks.en: Development-stage testing: all methods are applicable; used to establish baseline data and acceptance criteria for seal integrity

blocks.zh: 製程中測試：只有非破壞性方法（RSF 例外）適用——取樣監控
blocks.en: In-process testing: only non-destructive methods are applicable (RSF is an exception); used for sampling-based monitoring

blocks.zh: 100% 在線檢查：僅少數非破壞性方法（HVLD、HSA、真空/壓力衰減、氣體電離）適用——全數檢查
blocks.en: 100% in-line inspection: only a few non-destructive methods (HVLD, HSA, vacuum/pressure decay, gas ionization) are applicable; used for inspection of every unit

blocks.zh: 實務選擇指南
blocks.en: Practical Selection Guide

blocks.zh: 選擇 CCIT 方法時需考慮：
blocks.en: The following should be considered when selecting a CCIT method:

blocks.zh: 容器類型（安瓿、西林瓶、預充填注射器各適合不同方法）
blocks.en: Container type (ampoules, vials and prefilled syringes each suit different methods)

blocks.zh: 產品特性（導電性、頂空要求、穩定性）
blocks.en: Product characteristics (conductivity, headspace requirements, stability)

blocks.zh: 設備通量（是否需要匹配充填線速度）
blocks.en: Equipment throughput (whether it needs to match the filling line speed)

blocks.zh: 法規市場要求（部分市場要求 100% 檢查）
blocks.en: Regulatory market requirements (some markets require 100% inspection)

blocks.zh: 洩漏偵測靈敏度（不同方法的偵測下限不同）
blocks.en: Leak detection sensitivity (detection limits differ between methods)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：關鍵 CCIT 方法解析
blocks.en: Key Point: Analysis of Key CCIT Methods

blocks.zh: PAT（製程分析技術）的應用趨勢：透過持續監控 CPP 來降低或取消抽樣檢查需求。
blocks.en: Application trend for PAT (process analytical technology): continuously monitoring CPPs to reduce or eliminate the need for sampling-based inspection.

blocks.zh: Vial Capping/Crimping / 西林瓶壓蓋/壓封
blocks.en: Vial Capping/Crimping

blocks.zh: 核心概念：壓蓋前的密封完整性風險
blocks.en: Core Concept: Seal Integrity Risk Before Capping

blocks.zh: 法規立場非常明確：西林瓶在鋁蓋壓封完成前，不被視為密封完整。這意味著：
blocks.en: The regulatory position is very clear: a vial is not considered to have an integral seal until the crimp cap has been applied. This means that:

blocks.zh: 從充填區到壓蓋區之間的轉運過程中，產品處於「未完全密封」狀態
blocks.en: during transfer from the filling area to the capping area, the product is in a "not fully sealed" state

blocks.zh: 必須使用 LP/GAAS（層流保護/Grade A 空氣供應）保護產品
blocks.en: the product must be protected with LP/GAAS (laminar flow protection/Grade A air supply)

blocks.zh: 必須在壓蓋前進行膠塞偵測（raised/missing stopper detection）
blocks.en: stopper detection (raised/missing stopper detection) must be performed before capping

blocks.zh: 不合格品必須在壓蓋前被剔除
blocks.en: rejects must be removed before capping

blocks.zh: 重點提示：膠塞偵測系統的精度要求
blocks.en: Key Point: Accuracy Requirements for Stopper Detection Systems

blocks.zh: 膠塞偵測系統必須能夠偵測：
blocks.en: The stopper detection system must be able to detect:

blocks.zh: 歪斜膠塞（Skewed stopper）：一側有縫隙、另一側正常
blocks.en: Skewed stoppers: a gap on one side while the other side is normal

blocks.zh: 整體上浮膠塞（Evenly lifted stopper）：膠塞均勻抬高
blocks.en: Evenly lifted stoppers: the stopper is raised uniformly

blocks.zh: 必須從至少 2 個方向（通常 90° 夾角）進行檢查
blocks.en: Inspection must be performed from at least 2 directions (usually at a 90° angle)

blocks.zh: 最靈敏的系統可偵測到 0.1mm 的間隙
blocks.en: The most sensitive systems can detect a gap of 0.1 mm

blocks.zh: 每種容器/膠塞組合的「最大允許間隙」都必須透過適當方法（如氦氣洩漏測試、HSA）獨立確定。
blocks.en: The "maximum allowable gap" for each container/stopper combination must be determined independently by an appropriate method (such as helium leak testing or HSA).

blocks.zh: 壓蓋 PAT 技術五大進展
blocks.en: Five PAT Developments in Capping

blocks.zh: 氣動預壓縮：取代彈簧，可集中調整、持續監控和警報
blocks.en: Pneumatic pre-compression: replaces springs and allows central adjustment, continuous monitoring and alarms

blocks.zh: 應變計確認：壓蓋過程中即時確認壓縮力
blocks.en: Strain gauge confirmation: confirms the compression force in real time during capping

blocks.zh: 旋轉監測：偵測壓封時容器是否打滑（導致密封不良）
blocks.en: Rotation monitoring: detects whether the container slips during crimping (which would result in a poor seal)

blocks.zh: 殘留密封力（RSF）測試：監控壓封後的殘餘壓縮力
blocks.en: Residual seal force (RSF) testing: monitors the residual compression force after crimping

blocks.zh: 視覺壓封檢查：攝像機即時檢查壓封外觀品質
blocks.en: Visual crimp inspection: cameras inspect the appearance quality of the crimp in real time

blocks.zh: 這些 PAT 應用正在將壓蓋從「事後檢查」轉變為「即時控制」的製程。
blocks.en: These PAT applications are turning capping from a "post-event inspection" process into one under "real-time control".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：多頭壓蓋機的按主軸監控
blocks.en: Key Point: Per-Spindle Monitoring on Multi-Head Cappers

blocks.zh: 多頭壓蓋機中，每個壓蓋頭（spindle）可能產生不同的缺陷模式。因此：
blocks.en: On a multi-head capper, each capping head (spindle) may produce a different defect pattern. Therefore:

blocks.zh: 控制系統必須能夠按單個主軸追蹤連續缺陷（如主軸 #1 連續出現 3 次缺陷）
blocks.en: the control system must be able to track consecutive defects per individual spindle (for example, spindle #1 showing 3 consecutive defects)

blocks.zh: 取樣組必須對應定義的主軸順序（如 1–12 號頭依序取樣）
blocks.en: sampling groups must correspond to a defined spindle sequence (for example, heads 1–12 sampled in order)

blocks.zh: 這與充填機按單個充填頭取樣的邏輯相同
blocks.en: This is the same logic as sampling per individual filling head on a filling machine

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：壓蓋如同開瓶的逆向操作
blocks.en: Analogy: Capping Is the Reverse of Opening a Bottle

blocks.zh: 想像用開瓶器開啤酒——壓蓋就是這個動作的逆向過程。鋁蓋被放在膠塞上方，先施加向下壓力確保膠塞緊貼瓶口，然後滾輪將鋁蓋邊緣捲入瓶頸凸緣下方鎖定。如果壓蓋時瓶子打滑（rotation），就像用開瓶器時瓶蓋歪了——密封就會失敗。
blocks.en: Think of opening a beer with a bottle opener: capping is the reverse of that action. The aluminum cap is placed over the stopper, downward pressure is first applied to ensure the stopper sits tightly against the vial opening, and then rollers curl the edge of the cap under the lip of the vial neck to lock it in place. If the vial slips (rotation) during capping, it is like a bottle cap sitting crooked when you use an opener, and the seal will fail.

blocks.zh: 微粒管理：壓蓋區的特殊挑戰
blocks.en: Particulate Management: Special Challenges in the Capping Area

blocks.zh: 壓蓋過程中金屬碾壓會產生大量微粒。如果壓蓋在 ISO 5/Grade A 環境內進行，微粒管理尤為重要：
blocks.en: Metal rolling during capping generates a large number of particles. If capping is performed inside an ISO 5/Grade A environment, particulate management is especially important:

blocks.zh: 單向氣流設計必須將微粒從關鍵區域吹走
blocks.en: The unidirectional airflow design must sweep particles away from critical areas

blocks.zh: 需要調整風速、回風口位置，可能使用 RABS/隔離器內部隔板
blocks.en: Air velocity and return air grille positions need to be adjusted, and baffles inside the RABS/isolator may be used

blocks.zh: 白色翻蓋特別容易因微粒而變色——需考慮蓋子顏色選擇和分選碗清潔頻率
blocks.en: White flip-off caps are particularly prone to discoloration from particles, so cap color selection and the cleaning frequency of the sorting bowl need to be considered

blocks.zh: 為什麼 EU Annex 1 認為西林瓶在壓蓋完成前不算「密封完整」？如果膠塞已經完全壓入，為什麼還不夠？
blocks.en: Why does EU Annex 1 consider a vial not to be "integral" until capping is complete? If the stopper is already fully seated, why is that not enough?

blocks.zh: 一台 12 頭壓蓋機中，3 號和 7 號頭各出現了 2 次連續缺陷。根據「按主軸監控」原則，你會採取什麼行動？
blocks.en: On a 12-head capper, heads 3 and 7 each showed 2 consecutive defects. What action would you take under the per-spindle monitoring principle?

blocks.zh: 比較在無菌區內壓蓋和在無菌區外壓蓋的優缺點——各需要哪些額外措施？
blocks.en: Compare the advantages and disadvantages of capping inside the aseptic area versus outside it. What additional measures does each require?

blocks.zh: Section Summary / 本章重點回顧
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Sterile Filtration Systems (3.2.4): Three system configurations (aseptically assembled, SIP multi-use, pre-sterilized single-use) with a clear industry trend toward single-use systems. Redundant filtration and pre/post-use filter integrity testing are regulatory essentials. / 無菌過濾系統：三種組態從手動組裝到單次使用演進，冗餘過濾與完整性測試為法規基本要求。
blocks.en: Sterile Filtration Systems (3.2.4): Three system configurations (aseptically assembled, SIP multi-use, pre-sterilized single-use) with a clear industry trend toward single-use systems. Redundant filtration and pre/post-use filter integrity testing are regulatory essentials.

blocks.zh: Bulk Product Holding: Hold time validation is critical. Post-filtration sterile hold requires continuous overpressure monitoring. Minimize hold time; sustained holds are exceptions. / 散裝產品保存：保存時間驗證為稽查重點，無菌保存需持續正壓監控，原則上儘快過濾。
blocks.en: Bulk Product Holding: Hold time validation is critical. Post-filtration sterile hold requires continuous overpressure monitoring. Minimize hold time; sustained holds are exceptions.

blocks.zh: Container Preparation: Four contamination types to control (bioburden, endotoxin, particulates, chemicals). Washing + depyrogenation tunnel (250-350 deg C) for glass; RTU containers are an emerging CDMO trend. / 容器準備：控制四類污染，洗瓶 + 去熱原隧道為傳統方案，即用型容器為 CDMO 新趨勢。
blocks.en: Container Preparation: Four contamination types to control (bioburden, endotoxin, particulates, chemicals). Washing + depyrogenation tunnel (250-350 deg C) for glass; RTU containers are an emerging CDMO trend.

blocks.zh: Closure Preparation: WFI rinse mandatory, stopper moisture content critical for lyophilized products. RTU/RTS closures increasingly adopted. / 膠塞準備：WFI 沖洗為必要條件，凍乾產品特別注意膠塞含水量。
blocks.en: Closure Preparation: WFI rinse mandatory, stopper moisture content critical for lyophilized products. RTU/RTS closures increasingly adopted.

blocks.zh: Filling and Sealing: Highest-risk step in aseptic processing. Three filling methods (piston, time-pressure, peristaltic). 16 key design considerations for filling machines centered on isolation, cleanability, UAF, quick changeover, and process control. / 充填與密封：無菌製程最高風險環節，充填機設計以隔離、可清潔、氣流、快換線、製程控制為五大原則。
blocks.en: Filling and Sealing: Highest-risk step in aseptic processing. Three filling methods (piston, time-pressure, peristaltic). 16 key design considerations for filling machines centered on isolation, cleanability, UAF, quick changeover, and process control.

blocks.zh: BFS Technology: Integrates container forming, filling, and sealing in one machine. Two designs (shuttle vs. rotary). Best for high-volume continuous production; not suitable for lyophilized or heat-sensitive biologics. / BFS 技術：一體成型降低污染風險，適合大批量連續生產，不適用凍乾或熱敏生物製劑。
blocks.en: BFS Technology: Integrates container forming, filling, and sealing in one machine. Two designs (shuttle vs. rotary). Best for high-volume continuous production; not suitable for lyophilized or heat-sensitive biologics.

blocks.zh: Lyophilization (3.2.5): Three-phase process (freezing, sublimation, desorption) with 15-step operational sequence. Lyophilizer is the production bottleneck and one of the most expensive equipment investments. Loading/unloading automation, CIP/SIP between batches, and cycle optimization are key design drivers. / 凍乾：三階段 15 步操作，凍乾機是產線瓶頸且為最昂貴設備投資，自動進出料和週期優化是設計核心。
blocks.en: Lyophilization (3.2.5): Three-phase process (freezing, sublimation, desorption) with 15-step operational sequence. Lyophilizer is the production bottleneck and one of the most expensive equipment investments. Loading/unloading automation, CIP/SIP between batches, and cycle optimization are key design drivers.

blocks.zh: Container Closure Systems (3.2.6): CCI requires lifecycle approach (development, manufacturing, stability). 10 CCIT methods with different applicability for development, in-process, and 100% inspection. / 容器密封系統：CCI 需生命週期驗證，10 種 CCIT 方法按場景分層應用。
blocks.en: Container Closure Systems (3.2.6): CCI requires lifecycle approach (development, manufacturing, stability). 10 CCIT methods with different applicability for development, in-process, and 100% inspection.

blocks.zh: Vial Capping/Crimping: Container not considered fully integral until crimp seal is complete (FDA/EMA). LP/GAAS and stopper detection required. Five PAT developments transforming capping from post-check to real-time control. / 壓蓋/壓封：法規認定壓蓋前密封不完整，需 LP/GAAS 和膠塞偵測，五項 PAT 進展推動即時控制。
blocks.en: Vial Capping/Crimping: Container not considered fully integral until crimp seal is complete (FDA/EMA). LP/GAAS and stopper detection required. Five PAT developments transforming capping from post-check to real-time control.
